title: QUESTIONNAIRES — General Health
description: Self-rated health, activity limitation, mood, social-activity and health-belief items from the questionnaire.
$comment: Same items as the SF-36 questionnaire block of other CD3 studies, without the computed SF scores (the dictionary lists none here).
